title: County-ag profiles batch (N counties via the pilot template)
context: After the M0 pilot (pilot-008) proves the county-ag end-to-end pattern for one county, this task applies the same template to a batch of N counties. The shared toolkit, gate checklist, and Methodology Card schema make each additional county cheap and consistent to produce. County selection follows the region rubric (regionrubric-006) to avoid cherry-picking.
objective: Build county-ag profile explainers for a batch of N counties (USDA NASS Quick Stats) using the pilot-008 template and shared toolkit, passing gate-003 and accessibility for each county in the batch.
acceptanceCriteria: Each county profile uses the pilot-008 template and shared toolkit (toolkit-002); gate-003 PASS recorded per county (PD source; output CC-BY-4.0; no PII).
Figures for each county reproduce in CI from committed code + USDA NASS source snapshot; counties chosen per the region rubric (regionrubric-006).
Accessibility pass (WCAG 2.2 AA, reading grade <= 8) signed off for each explainer in the batch.
License reviewer and Methodology+Stats reviewer sign-offs obtained for the batch as a whole.
At least 3 county explainers delivered in the batch, each with an outcomes record or a delivered-pending note identifying the adoption blocker.
resources: REGION-RUBRIC.md — Region-selection rubric and harm-scan checklist (prerequisite for region selection)
output: A batch of at least 3 county-ag profile explainers (committed static tools + plain-language content + Methodology Cards + gate artifacts + accessibility sign-offs + outcomes records or delivered-pending notes).
